full_track.tags: Trot, Korean adult contemporary. Baritone male vocals with heavy vibrato and traditional phrasing. Accordion playing melodic counter-lines and rhythmic stabs. Clean electric guitar with light chorus and reverb playing arpeggiated chords. Acoustic piano providing harmonic support. Electric bass playing a steady root-fifth pattern. Drum kit with a prominent snare on beats two and four and a steady hi-hat pulse. 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of C Major.
